# Fixture proving the offset ban fires. Not a real module (.txt so nothing
# collects or imports it).
from sqlalchemy import select, text

from shared.db import Base


def bad_orm_list(page: int, size: int):
    return select(Base).limit(size).offset(page * size)


def bad_raw_sql(page: int, size: int):
    return text(f"SELECT * FROM content.things LIMIT {size} OFFSET {page * size}")
